'''Boyapati Manoranjan Choudary''' (born 1946) is an Indian inorganic chemist and a former senior scientist at [[Indian Institute of Chemical Technology]].<ref name="Dr. B.M.Choudary Choudary">{{Cite web |url=http://www.organicworldwide.net/content/choudary |title=Dr. B.M.Choudary Choudary |date=2016 |publisher=Organic Chemistry Resources Worldwide}}</ref> He is known for his studies on [[Nanomaterials]] to [[Nanomedicine]]<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=422 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2016 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> and is an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]],<ref name="Indian fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P04-1354 |title=Indian fellow |date=2016 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy}}</ref> and the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Choudary,_Dr_Boyapati_Manoranjan |title=Fellow profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 1990, for his contributions to chemical sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref>

== Biography ==
[[File:CSIR IICT Hyderabad.jpg|thumb|235px|Indian Institute of Chemical Technology]]
B. M. Choudary, born on 10 August 1946 in the south Indian state of [[Andhra Pradesh]], graduated in chemistry from [[Andhra University]] and completed his master's degree at [[Vikram University]].<ref name="Indian fellow" /> His career started as a junior lecturer in chemistry at [[Kakatiya Medical College]] in 1970 and after three years, he joined [[Indian Institute of Chemical Technology]] (IICT) as a junior research fellow where he spent the rest of his academic career to retire as a senior scientist. In between, he secured a PhD from [[Gujarat University]] in 1980 for his thesis on ''Catalysis in Organic Chemistry''.<ref name="Indian fellow" /> After retirement, he founded Ogene Systems in 2005 where he serves as the managing director.<ref name="Board of Directors">{{Cite web |url=http://ogene.co.in/management.html |title=Board of Directors |date=2016 |publisher=Ogene Systems |access-date=24 November 2016 |archive-date=11 December 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161211163740/http://ogene.co.in/management.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Choudary's researches on anchored intercalated catalysts returned high selectivity and activity and his work on homogeneous catalysis using transition metal complexes widened the knowledge on the subject.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{cite web | url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=1999 | access-date=5 October 2016 | pages=34 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | archive-date=4 March 2016 | url-status=dead }}</ref> He established a laboratory for researches on catalysis and surface science at Indian Institute of Chemical Technology and hosted a number of researchers there. He published his research findings by way of several peer-reviewed articles<ref name="Browse by Fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Choudary=3ABoyapati_Manoranjan=3A=3A.html |title=Browse by Fellow |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and [[Google Scholar]], an online repository of scientific particles, has listed 258 of them.<ref name="On Google Scholar">{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=R1MxH_EAAAAJ&hl=en |title=On Google Scholar |date=2016 |publisher=Google Scholar}}</ref> He has mentored 50 doctoral scholars in their studies and holds over several US and Indian patents.<ref name="Dr B.M. Choudary gets AP Scientist Award">{{Cite web |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/bline/2004/03/06/stories/2004030602661703.htm |title=Dr B.M. Choudary gets AP Scientist Award |date=6 March 2004 |work=The Hindu}}</ref>

In 2005, Choudary founded Ogene Systems, a firm handling research and manufacturing contracts where he guides several teams engaged in research in nanotechnology, nanomedicine, process development and manufacturing.<ref name="Board of Directors" /> He is a former member of the editorial board of the ''Journal of Molecular Catalysis A: Chemical'' and serves as a guest editor for ''Topics in Catalysis'' journal.<ref name="Indian fellow" /> He has also participated in international meetings on catalysis.<ref name="GucziSolymosi1993">{{cite book|author1=L. Guczi|author2=F. Solymosi|author3=P. Tétényi|title=New Frontiers in Catalysis, Parts A-C|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=rq1wlpeYytsC&pg=PA1254|date=20 April 1993|publisher=Elsevier|isbn=978-0-08-088714-2|pages=1254–}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 1990.<ref name="Chemical Sciences">{{cite web|url=http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm |title=Chemical Sciences |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research |date=2016 |access-date=7 November 2016 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120912012851/http://www.csir.res.in/external/heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm |archive-date=12 September 2012 }}</ref> The Indian Academy of Sciences elected him as their fellow in 1992<ref name="Fellow profile" /> and he became an elected fellow of the Indian National Science Academy in 2004. The same year, the Government of Andhra Pradesh awarded him the Andhra Pradesh Scientist Award.<ref name="Dr B.M. Choudary gets AP Scientist Award" /> He is also an elected fellow of the Andhra Pradesh Academy of Sciences.<ref name="Indian fellow" />
